user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Summer Beach Boardwalk. A sunny beach boardwalk: a turning ferris wheel with colored gondolas, an ice-cream stand with a striped awning, rows of beach umbrellas and towels on the sand, surfboards racked by a rental shack, seagulls hovering, a lifeguard tower, gentle animated waves rolling in, an arcade facade with bulbs, and heat-bright blue sky with puffy clouds. Style: bright vacation pop. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
